title: Lens
description: An industry overlay manifest that composes with base Programs by adding or overriding steering, skills, exit criteria, or tags. Lenses never silently remove program behavior; they can augment (add*) or override (override*). See design.md Lens Schema and Composition Semantics.

industry.description: Industry vertical this lens applies to. Must match the intention schema industry enum.

overlays.description: Per-program overlays applied when this lens activates. At least one overlay is required.

tags.description: Free-form tags for search and filtering.

lensOverlay.description: A single program overlay: augments or overrides the targeted program's steering, skills, exit criteria, or tags.

targetProgram.description: The program id this overlay augments.

addSteering.description: Relative paths to steering files appended to the target program's steering (append-then-dedupe).

addSkills.description: Relative paths to skill files appended to the target program's skills (append-then-dedupe).

addExitCriteria.description: Exit criteria appended to the target program's exit criteria. Entries whose id already exists in the base are silently skipped unless this overlay also overrides them.

overrideExitCriteria.description: Exit criteria that replace the base program's exit criteria by id. Missing ids raise a diagnostic.

additionalTags.description: Additional tags appended to the target program's tags.
